CheckBox.android:text: Refresh only channels missing guide data

TextView.android:text: How long before a program starts a Guide "Remind Me" notification fires — gives you time to actually switch over instead of finding out right as it starts.

CheckBox.android:text: No guide from your provider? Use the default US guide

TextView.android:text: Used when a stream offers multiple language tracks. If your provider doesn't tag languages, this has no effect.
Bypass ISP throttling by encrypting DNS queries
Lets the device handle audio/video sync in hardware — smoother on supported devices, but can cause glitches on some. Off by default.
Maps Dolby Vision Profile 7 content to standard HEVC for devices without proper DV7 hardware support

Forces stereo audio instead of Dolby/DTS passthrough — turn this on only if some channels/movies have no sound at all. Off by default since it disables surround sound on setups that do have a receiver.
Shows a cancelable 10-second Up Next prompt and auto-advances to the next episode when one finishes. On by default.
Enable extra buffering for all servers by default — trades a slower start/seek for fewer mid-playback stalls. On by default.

How fast a live channel keeps retrying after a dropped/stalled connection. Aggressive retries quickly with a lower ceiling; Patient waits longer between attempts — useful for slower or less reliable providers.

Caps video at 480p / about 1.2 Mbps for slow Wi-Fi like on a plane. Only helps on channels your provider offers in more than one quality — a single-quality channel plays as usual. Takes effect the next time a channel starts.
Shrink live playback into a small floating window when you leave the app (e.g. press Home) instead of stopping it. On by default.
Hold a channel's logo in the list to play a small muted preview before you commit to tuning in. Uses a real connection to your provider per preview, so it's off by default.
Experimental — only works if your provider labels movie/series categories with an EN/ENG/ENGLISH/US/USA tag.
Automatically clears an in-progress movie or show from Continue Watching once you haven't touched it for this long. It reappears if you actually resume it later.
Use the TV interface and D-pad navigation on this device even though it's not detected as a TV — for a car head unit/box or other non-standard screen. Restarts the app.
Watch up to 6 channels at once in a grid, with audio following whichever tile you select.
Skips the install confirmation screen for updates when Android allows it. Off by default.
Notifies you when a favorited show gets a new episode (checked daily)
Sync favorites and watch history across your devices using Firebase.
Pairing Code (enter another device's sync code)
Automatically sends crash details so bugs can be found and fixed without you needing to send a debug report. No account info is included.

Off by default. When on, a hashed (never the raw URL or your login) provider identifier plus the channel name and error type are shared anonymously so other users can see "N people reported issues with this channel recently". No account info is included.
Connect Trakt to automatically track your movie and episode watch activity.
